save.description: The button that saves the record being edited.

saving.description: The save button while the save is under way.

reset.description: The button beside the save button that drops every change not yet saved and puts the record back as it was last saved.

delete.description: The button that deletes the record being edited.

deleting.description: The delete button while the deletion is under way.

confirm.description: The question asked before a record is deleted. `name` is the record's title or name.

failed.description: What the editor says when a save or a deletion fails and the error carries no message of its own.

edit.description: The action on a table's row that opens the record's editor.

slug.description: The label of the field for a record's slug: the last part of its page's address.

slugHint.description: The hint under the slug field: how a slug is written.

summary.description: The label of the field for a record's one-line summary.

updated.description: The heading of the table column for when a record was last changed.

created.description: The heading of the table column for when a record was added.

cancel.description: The button that leaves an editor and drops the changes not yet saved.

actions.description: The button in a page's header that opens the menu of what can be done to the record: delete it, for one.
